messages:
maria: Quick sync — we need to lock ownership and a very small timeline for the console observability retention gate. Can the 'gatekeepers' (storage, trace hooks, query) confirm owners + a simple ETA?
kevin: I can own query perf + dashboard index changes. ETA: small spike to validate by Tue EOD.
sylvia: I'll take trace hooks rollout and the staging canary. PRs: #4523 & #4531, awaiting review.
raj: Storage schema changes depend on the cost estimate from infra. @kevin do you need a different indexing layout?
kevin: Possibly. If we keep the event index + summary index we can hit 90d retention w/out huge cost. Need final numbers from infra.
anna: From infra: rough numbers look ok for 90d, 365d needs compaction + cold-tiering. We can prototype compaction this sprint.
maria: Ok — decision points: (1) target default retention 90d, optional 365d behind feature flag, (2) canary for trace hooks in staging then prod gradual rollout, (3) query perf sweep before GA.
obs-bot: [deploy] canary started for trace-hooks v2 on staging (build 2026-03-16T09:12Z) :rocket:
kevin: small ask — can the dashboard team add a lightweight error-analysis view that surfaces top 5 regressions by alert count? We can wire the retention SLO to that.
sylvia: yep, I can add a minimal view. Will use the new trace fields and a sample rate column.
raj: blockers: need schema migration plan. Suggest this pattern in SQL: ```ALTER TABLE traces ADD COLUMN sampled BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE; UPDATE traces SET sampled = true WHERE rand() < 0.01;``` will run in rolling batches. Thoughts?
anna: safe approach. Run in batches and limit to <1% QPS impact. I'll schedule a migration window.
maria: Action items: 
- kevin: perf validation by Tue EOD (confirm indexing)
- sylvia: complete canary PR reviews + add error-analysis stub by Wed
- anna: migration window + cost delta for 365d by Thu
- raj: draft migration playbook and rollback steps
I'll follow up in this thread with a short checklist. Thanks :heart: 
kevin: noted. ping me if you need timeboxed pairing.
sylvia: will @maria when PRs ready.
raj: putting the migration playbook draft at https://rwd.internal/s/trace-migrate-316 — feedback welcome.
maria: Great. If anything slips, call it out here and we'll re-scope. Closing loop for now.
